historical_growth.basis: All series converted to USD millions. FY2020-FY2022 were reported in CNY and are converted at annual average USD/CNY 6.90, 6.45, 6.73; FY2023 onward are the company's own USD figures (the FY2024 AR restated FY2023 in USD). Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC (interest sits in investing CF, see inputs.interest_income_note).
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr (USD basis), used as the year-1/2 anchor and decelerated; equity CAGR is unusable here
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (+45.9%) is an IPO artefact (June 2021 listing raised ~USD400m) and the 3yr figure (-0.9%) reflects USD249m of special dividends since FY2023, so neither measures business growth. EPS CAGRs are flat-to-negative because FY2022-FY2023 profit collapsed (China price cuts, global ramp-up losses) before recovering in FY2025. Revenue compounded at ~25% throughout; profit and owner FCF are only now (FY2025, H1 FY2026) back above their FY2021 level.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR is undefined (FY2022 base USD4.8m, FY2023-FY2024 negative). The 5yr owner-FCF CAGR (-1.0%) is essentially flat while revenue tripled: FY2020 owner FCF was inflated by a CNY-era deferred-revenue surge (prepaid China treatment plans) and FY2023-FY2024 absorbed the overseas build-out. SBC has fallen from 8.1% of revenue (FY2020) to 2.5% (FY2025) and 1.3% (H1 FY2026), so the owner-FCF series has caught UP to reported FCF rather than lagged it.

scenario_narratives.base: Angelalign compounds revenue at ~25% for the next three years then decelerates to low single digits by FY2035, while the global segment (now over half of cases, just breakeven) converges toward the China segment's 24% operating margin. Operating leverage is the thesis: gross margin has been stable at 62-63% for three years, so every point of growth above opex growth drops through. Year-10 owner-FCF margin ~14.5% on ~USD1.35bn revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: Global ex-China keeps growing 50%+ for two more years, Align litigation resolves benignly, China ASP stabilises as KiD and complex cases lift mix, and group margins reach Align-like 28% pre-SBC.
scenario_narratives.bear: China pricing policy and Align's competitive/legal response compress both growth and margin: revenue growth falls to single digits by FY2029 and the group plateaus at a 20% pre-SBC EBITDA margin with 24% cash tax.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF in USD, converted to HKD at the pegged rate. SBC (2.5% of revenue, falling) is expensed and the diluted count held flat; interest is not double-stripped because the company already reports it outside OCF; the USD384m post-dividend cash pile (incl. term deposits and wealth-management products) is added once in the bridge. The valuation turns on whether the global segment can reach China-like margins before growth fades; the terminal value is capped at 18x year-10 owner FCF in the base case.
key_risks_to_valuation: China ASP compression from provincial volume-based procurement or further 'strategic pricing adjustments' (H1 FY2026: cases +37%, China revenue +25%)
Align Technology patent litigation in E.D. Texas, the ITC and the UPC: an exclusion order would shut the US channel inside the global segment
Global segment margin may never converge to China's: clinical-support and sales headcount scale with cases, and ex-China manufacturing ramp-up costs were deferred in FY2025
Repatriation: most cash is onshore RMB; 5-10% withholding tax applies on distribution and letters-of-credit borrowing (USD69m) was used to bridge dividends in H1 FY2026
HNTE 15% preferential tax status requires periodic re-approval; statutory PRC rate is 25%
Geopolitics and tariffs on medical devices shipped from China; evolving data-protection rules on patient scans
Capital allocation: USD219m of special dividends in 12 months is shareholder-friendly but reduces the cash cushion the bridge relies on; the model deducts the September 2026 payment

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 58.40-100.00 HKD; USDHKD=X 7.8414 same date
data_sources.financials: 6699.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics; CNY FY2020-FY2022, USD FY2023 onward), FY2025 annual report (segment summary, adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation, cash-flow notes, tax note), H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet 30 June 2026, segment note 6, diluted EPS note 11, dividends note 24, borrowings paragraph)
data_sources.qualitative: FY2025 annual report business review and outlook; H1 FY2026 interim MD&A and outlook. 6699.HK_Analysis.json did not exist at build time.

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted weighted-average count for diluted EPS, H1 FY2026 interim note 11(b): 169,542,751 in issue + 907,011 unvested RSUs/options = 170,449,762. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice. Share scheme headroom of 7.51% of issued capital is ungranted and not modelled.
inputs.cash_composition: 30 June 2026 balance sheet (USD'000): cash and equivalents 172,529 + restricted cash 488 + term deposits >3 months current 200,213 + term deposits >3 months non-current 67,619 + wealth-management products at FVTPL (current) 42,388 = 483,237; LESS the H1 2026 interim + special dividend of HKD4.57/share (USD99,577k, note 24) which went ex on 16 Sep 2026 and was paid 25 Sep 2026, before the price date -> 383,660. Non-current FVTPL (unlisted equity investments, 46,166) and equity-method investments (15,175) are NOT cash-like and sit in equity_bridge instead. Debt = bank borrowings 70,976 current + 529 non-current (RMB letters-of-credit loans 69.2m drawn in H1 to fund the dividend while onshore deposits matured, plus Aditek BRL loan). Lease liabilities (12,954) excluded under lease treatment (B).
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income is NOT deducted from reported FCF here because Angelalign classifies 'Interest received' (USD24,482k FY2025) in INVESTING activities and its OCF reconciliation strips both finance income (3,689k) and term-deposit interest booked in other income (9,945k) out of profit before tax (FY2025 AR cash-flow note). Reported OCF and FCF are therefore already ex-interest; deducting it again would double-strip ~USD13.6m/yr. The cash pile is counted once, in net_debt, and the forward EBITDA margin path is an OPERATING margin that excludes other income, FV gains/losses on investments and FX.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation, 'Share-based payments' 9,133 (FY2024 11,290); ties to cash-flow add-back. EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in every year (no net-share-settlement tax line disclosed), so sbc_incl_equity_taxes = sbc.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases in FY2025 or H1 FY2026 (USD130k in FY2024, USD5.0m in FY2023). The flat count is a modelling convention the company funds through ordinary dilution, not buybacks; capital returns are paid as special dividends (USD119.5m paid H1 2026, USD99.6m paid Sep 2026).
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in USD (reporting currency switched from RMB to USD in the FY2023 annual report, prior-year comparatives restated; CNY years FY2020-FY2022 converted at average rates 6.90 / 6.45 / 6.73 for the historical CAGRs only). Quote is HKD on HKEX. USD->HKD 7.8414 from Yahoo USDHKD=X at 2026-10-23; HKD is pegged in a 7.75-7.85 band so the rate is stable. No dual listing exists for a parity check; per-share values are computed in USD and multiplied by 7.8414 to HKD.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-23T08:08:08Z (HKEX regular close, Friday; valuation written Saturday 2026-10-24, no after-hours print)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are USD, so WACC is built from USD inputs: 10y UST ~4.1% + beta 1.25 x ERP 5.0% = 10.35%, plus ~0.65pp for China operating/regulatory exposure of a HK-listed mid-cap -> 11.0% cost of equity. Net-cash balance sheet (bank debt USD71.5m vs USD384m cash-like) so WACC = cost of equity. Single WACC across all three scenarios: cyclicality, China pricing policy and the Align patent litigation are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked into the discount rate (adaptations 7f).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) Leases as operating cost. Lease cash (principal + interest on lease liabilities, both from the cash-flow statement: FY2025 4,835 + 609 = USD5.44m = 1.47% of revenue; H1 FY2026 2,739 + 347 = USD3.09m = 1.34%) is charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (USD12.95m) are EXCLUDED from net debt; D&A for the tax line is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 PPE depreciation 10,857 + amortisation 2,403 = 13,260 = 3.6% of revenue; ROU depreciation 5,167 excluded).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; the non-controlling interest (Aditek, Brazil; book value USD3.14m at 30 June 2026, loss-attributable in both H1 2025 and H1 2026) is deducted once in equity_bridge at book value. Attributable profit H1 FY2026 USD27.25m vs consolidated 25.45m, so attributable-only flows would be slightly HIGHER than modelled; deducting book is the conservative choice.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md row 2: operating company, non-US) with the adaptations file applied for (a) USD reporting vs HKD quote, (b) one lease treatment, (c) NCI, (d) excluded income / matching assets. Angelalign is China's leading clear-aligner maker, now with more cases outside mainland China (H1 FY2026: 168,001 global ex-China vs 148,608 China; revenue 118.2m vs 112.5m) and a global segment that just reached breakeven (segment profit USD0.56m H1 FY2026 vs -5.43m H1 FY2025) while the China segment runs a 24% operating margin. No prior DCF, no Analysis JSON existed at build time: business context taken directly from the FY2025 annual report and H1 FY2026 interim. FY0 is FY2025 (last full year); year 1 is FY2026, for which H1 is reported (+42.9% revenue). Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 50.387 - SBC 9.133 = 41.254 (interest already excluded from OCF, see interest_income_note). FY2025 reported FCF carried ~USD25m of working-capital inflow (deferred revenue +42m); the component build does not carry that forward (year-1 owner-FCF margin ~7.5% vs 11.1% FY2025 actual). Horizon 10 years because margins are still ramping (H1 FY2026 operating EBITDA pre-SBC ~17.7% vs FY2025 ~14.7%). Repatriation friction: most cash sits in PRC subsidiaries; USD9.3m withholding tax was accrued in H1 FY2026 on planned distributions and is deducted in the bridge; the remaining 5-10% WHT drag on future repatriation is carried in the rising cash_tax_rate_path rather than as a cash haircut.

bear.narrative: A repeat of FY2022-FY2024 in slower motion: China ASP is cut again ('strategic pricing adjustments' already took H1 FY2026 China revenue growth to +25% on +37% cases) under provincial volume-based procurement of orthodontic consumables, and the global segment's growth halves as Align responds on price and the US patent cases (ITC exclusion risk) or tariffs close the North American channel. Operating EBITDA stalls near 16-20% because global never reaches China-like margins while clinical-support headcount keeps scaling with cases. Cash tax drifts to 24% if HNTE status lapses (25% statutory) and withholding tax on repatriation recurs. Terminal growth 2.5%, cap 15x for a business whose pricing is partly set by policy.

base.narrative: FY2026 +35% (H1 reported +42.9%, H2 decelerating against a stronger FY2025 H2 base: 230.7 + ~275 = ~USD500m). Growth then steps down 25/20/16/13 as the global segment laps its launch years and China grows low-double-digit on lower-tier share gains and KiD/complex-case mix against continued ASP drift. Operating EBITDA (pre-SBC, IFRS-16, ex other income/FV/FX) ramps from ~17% (H1 FY2026 run-rate 17.7%) to 25% as the global segment converges toward the China segment's 24% operating margin; mature level sits below Align Technology's ~27%. Capex eases from 6.5% to 4% once the ex-China manufacturing sites are built; D&A ex-ROU drifts from 3.5% to 3.0%. Cash tax ramps 16% -> 21%: PRC HNTE 15% blended with newly-taxable overseas profits and recurring 5-10% withholding tax on the dividends the company funds from onshore earnings. Working capital captures 8% of the revenue increase (China prepaid plans positive, international receivables negative; FY2024 -20m, FY2025 +25m, H1 FY2026 +14m).

bull.narrative: Global ex-China keeps compounding at 50-60% for two more years (H1 FY2026 +65% revenue, +43% cases) as doctor word-of-mouth and the iMaster/Ascend education programmes convert top-tier orthodontists in Europe, APAC, Brazil and North America; the Align litigation (E.D. Texas, ITC, UPC) resolves without an exclusion order. China re-accelerates on lower-tier penetration and early-treatment (KiD) mix with ASP stabilising. Group operating EBITDA reaches 28% pre-SBC, in line with Align's history, as the ex-China plants ramp and global service infrastructure is fully leveraged. Terminal growth 3.5% and a 20x cap reflect a category still under-penetrated in every market.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the company has already lived the bear case once: FY2022-FY2024 profit collapsed from USD44m to USD7-10m on China price cuts and overseas launch losses while revenue kept growing, and H1 FY2026 China revenue grew 25% on 37% case growth (ASP still falling). The live Align patent litigation in the US (E.D. Texas, ITC, UPC Europe) is a single-adversary risk to the fastest-growing channel. Bull trimmed to 25% because it needs three independent things to hold at once: sustained 50%+ ex-China growth, a benign litigation outcome, and China ASP stabilisation. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
